# Reproducible relational model

A reporting owner needs a customer/order model including customers with no orders. Specify keys, cardinality and orphan checks.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
{
  "customers": [
    {
      "id": "C1",
      "orders": 2,
      "cents": 20000
    },
    {
      "id": "C2",
      "orders": 1,
      "cents": 6000
    },
    {
      "id": "C3",
      "orders": 0,
      "cents": 0
    }
  ],
  "orphans": []
}
```

## Failure prevented
An inner join drops the customer with zero orders.

files.query.sql: SELECT c.id,COUNT(o.id) AS orders,COALESCE(SUM(o.cents),0) AS cents FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer=c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id;
